answer: Farming becomes a bridge bet on surviving 85 epochs of grading, and every ridge settlement recomputes the delta schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 85 epochs rather than arriving at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
